description: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability across several medical specialties for two language models, Mistralv0.2-Base and Cardio. The horizontal axis represents the medical specialties—Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics—listed alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Negative log probability,” displays a logarithmic scale ranging from -22 to -27, with tick marks at intervals of 1. For each specialty, there are two bars representing the negative log probability for each model; the bars are colored orange for Cardio and light blue for Mistralv0.2-Base. Within each specialty, the height of the bars varies; for example, in the “Cardio” specialty, the orange bar extends to approximately -22.5, while the light blue bar extends to approximately -23.5. In the “Neuro” specialty, the light blue bar extends below the axis to approximately -28.5. The bars are arranged in pairs, one for each model, and are not visually emphasized beyond their color differentiation.
